notes: Remaining ToAbsoluteDouble3 uses are chunk/sector local packing or public absolute export and are not runtime-origin float conversions.
Runtime-origin conversions use AUPDeltaClamped/ResolveCameraRelative before float casts.
Paged sector hashes use integer grid-local sector quantization when AUP cell size is divisible by sector edge.
OffsetMeters and FromGridLocal canonicalize by carrying grid-local deltas instead of recomposing absolute doubles.
